answer: No claim rides free: it climbs a ferrous ladder. The agent starts on the ledge of a fresh job and faces three live steps of rising difficulty, each due within an hour and checked by a different stranger against a sealed reference. A wrong step, a copied step, or a missed deadline is a fall from the summit: claim dead, fee burned, identity barred a week. An honest worker pays five cents and one hour of real work; 1,000 fakes must climb 1,000 ladders and pay $50.
